_about: Architectural observations per building, written only from the listed reference photos (data/refs, sources in utdallas-map-areas/sources.csv). Each feature carries a confidence: high = clearly visible in an official photo; medium = visible but partial, oblique, or from one side only; low = inferred from a distant or aerial view. Features with no reference are left out and listed under 'unknown'. Recipe fields drive blender/build_buildings.py.

OSM.verification: The museum directory identifies 777 Loop Road SW as APC (Phase I). The published Morphosis site plan places Phase I at the north end of the plaza, with the Music Building directly south. Mapped way w1128100173 is the northern footprint (north edge -188 m), w1443116530 is the separate southern footprint (north edge approximately -260 m). The map orientation, recesses and projecting north room match the museum plan.

Crow Museum of Asian Art.photoPass: Fine-scale relief and sheen on white precast; recessed cantilever windows carry projecting mullions and retain their angled glazed slots. Renewed warm lobby glazing with no ramp or undercroft obstruction. Chamfered and tapered V-braces land at their mapped positions on shallow footings. Raised precast relief, roof creases and folded soffit trim share the opaque batch. Recessed windows have physical transoms and entry canopies have an articulated underside.

Comets LANding.signReview: SmithGroup's north exterior photograph shows clear upper glazing and a small white uppercase wordmark with a warm orange LAN outline visible through the ground-floor glass between the entrances.
